name: zgeometry_model_find_or_create_random_debug_material
description: zGeometry_Model::FindOrCreateRandomDebugMaterial resets a local material, assigns random debug RGB values, computes the packed 5:6:5 color, clones or reuses it through the material pool, and returns the selected material.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry/zModel material source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46a690 validates ResetDefaults on the stack material, three rand() calls scaled into green/red/blue debug channels, 5:6:5 packed-color construction, FindOrClone dispatch, global last-debug-material update, and returning the selected material.
The native material defaults/find smoke verifies the helper clones into the active material pool, updates the material reuse cache, and stores a packed color matching the generated RGB components.
